text:
Aisha: Quick sync notes from ClearWave onboarding  — two product asks that could impact their renewal (~6 weeks): 1) single CSV export that shows per-route token usage + cost columns so finance can reconcile, 2) ability to snooze/mute non-critical alerts during 9am-5pm local.
Tom: Can you get exact wording from the call? Want to drop into productboard.
Aisha: Quote: 'We need a one-click export to hand our FP&A team. Right now it takes manual joins across dashboards.' Also: 'Daily alert chatter is drowning our PMs during standups.'
Priya: Flagging renewal risk. If we can promise a short-term workaround + beta for full feature, they may renew.
Ravi: Dev quick take: (A) Per-route export: if we reuse existing aggregated counters, we can add CSV endpoint + UI download in ~2w. If we need to recompute cost attribution, ~4-6w. (B) Alert snooze: org-scheduled quiet hours + UI toggle behind FF: ~1-2w.
Sam: Suggest shipping snooze first (low effort), and offer an interim export that has route + token counts (no cost calc) while we add cost mapping.
Aisha: They asked specifically for cost numbers, but said they'll join a beta for accurate cost export if we give them interim CSV now. They volunteered sample CSV layout.
Tom: Action items: 1) Ravi to confirm dependency on aggregation pipeline and give precise ETA for both interim and full. 2) Aisha to upload sample CSV & confirm beta. 3) Sam to open productboard item and mark as renewal-risk. Check back in 72 hours.
Aisha: Uploaded sample to the shared drive (link). ClearWave confirmed beta participation. :thumbsup:
product-bot: Created PB-5519 "ClearWave: per-route usage export + alert snooze" with tag team=cs, impact=renewal-risk.
Priya: I'll add this to the weekly renewal sweep and notify AM.
Ravi: I'll post a short technical note in 24h with blockers if any.
Tom: Thanks everyone — interim path looks promising. Keep it hot.
